# Brand

> One-line positioning: who you help and what changes for them.

## About
- Name, title, credentials (only ones you can verify)
- Location / online availability, languages

## Offer
- Programme A: what it includes, price (incl./excl. VAT)
- Programme B: what it includes, price
- Free intro call: how to book (link)

## Who it's for
- Client profile 1
- Client profile 2
